summary: Master Agriculture Value Chain Development and Market Linkages with our expert-led course. Gain valuable insights and practical skills for success in the field.
lede: Agricultural value chain development training helps agriculture professionals map how products, finance and information move through markets. For agribusiness managers, project staff, cooperative leaders and policy advisers, it offers practical ways to identify bottlenecks and strengthen farmer-buyer relationships. Participants learn to assess market opportunities, build partnerships and design inclusive interventions for agricultural value chains.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who need to analyze, strengthen, and connect agricultural systems.
audience: Government officials in agriculture and trade ministries
Donor-funded project staff focused on market systems
modules: Principles of Agricultural Value Chain Development
Gender, Youth, and Inclusivity in Value Chains
Communicating and Scaling Value Chain Strategies
